info.name: @techelusive/nest-auth (local playground)
info.description:
Every endpoint of @techelusive/nest-auth.

1. Start the playground (npm run playground) and open http://localhost:3000/dev to watch emails, SMS and events.
2. Run requests top to bottom inside a folder. Tokens, codes and links are captured automatically into collection variables.
3. Change {{email}} / {{password}} in the collection variables to test other users.

exec: if (body.success === false) console.log("Error code:", body.code, "-", body.message);
// A deactivated account offers reactivation: keep the token for "Reactivate".
const read = (object, dottedPath) => dottedPath.split(".").reduce((value, key) => (value == null ? undefined : value[key]), object);
if (read(body, "accessToken") !== undefined) { pm.collectionVariables.set("accessToken", read(body, "accessToken")); console.log("saved accessToken"); }
if (read(body, "sessionId") !== undefined) { pm.collectionVariables.set("sessionId", read(body, "sessionId")); console.log("saved sessionId"); }
if (read(body, "user.id") !== undefined) { pm.collectionVariables.set("userId", read(body, "user.id")); console.log("saved userId"); }
